facts.value: Conditionally initializes a player-configured temporary fighter lifetime and its rendering setup. When Player_GetMoreFlagsBit0 is true, copies common-data x7DC and x7E0 into x2034 and x2038, sets x2227_b3, and calls ft_800C80A4 and ftCommon_80080460. Otherwise it performs no mutations. These are distinct from metal timer, health, and state. Their per-frame consumer decrements a nonzero x2034 under x2227_b3 and deactivates the fighter without the optional disappearance effect when the counter reaches zero or x2038 is nonpositive; an initially zero counter bypasses the health test.
